name: Be, Betsu ni Anta no Tame ni Oshiete Agerun Ja Nain Dakara ne!
original_name: べ、別にあんたの為に教えてあげるんじゃないんだからね！
source:
Hiroto failed university entrance exams. When he is down, two girls visit him all of a sudden. They are Tsukushi and Yui. They are sisters and hired as Hiroto's home tutors. He is encouraged to study hard again. Tsukushi and Yui, however, gradually fall in love with him and their battle for Hiroto now breaks out....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20081208073826/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011822]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
大翔在大学入学考试中落榜。就在他意志消沉时，两名少女突然前来拜访。她们是姐妹筑紫和唯，受雇担任大翔的家庭教师。在两人的鼓励下，大翔再次开始认真学习。然而，筑紫和唯却渐渐爱上了他，一场围绕大翔展开的争夺战就此打响…
